name: ascentix-rules-engine-client
description: Ascentix Rules Engine — client form library (Plan 4B-1, round-trip).

scripts.build: node scripts/build-docs.mjs && node scripts/build-font-css.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2015 --outfile=dist/asx_rulesengine.js && esbuild src/authoring/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2015 --outfile=dist/asx_authoringforms.js && esbuild src/editor/index.tsx --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --jsx=automatic --minify --outfile=dist/asx_ruleeditor.js
scripts.test:dev: vitest run --config vitest.config.dev.ts && node scripts/record-live-run.mjs l2
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/build-docs.mjs && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
